name: shopify-storefront-mcp-server
stderr:
Error: Shop domain is required.


Shopify Storefront MCP Server

Usage:
  npx shopify-storefront-mcp-server <shop-domain>

Arguments:
  shop-domain    The Shopify store domain (e.g., my-store.myshopify.com)

Examples:
  npx shopify-storefront-mcp-server my-store.myshopify.com
  npx shopify-storefront-mcp-server example-shop.myshopify.com

Environment Variables:
  SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN    Alternative way to specify the shop domain

Claude Desktop Configuration:
  Add this to your claude_desktop_config.json:

  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "shopify-storefront": {
        "command": "npx",
        "args": ["-y", "shopify-storefront-mcp-server", "your-store.myshopify.com"]
      }
    }
  }
